research_question: Owner-approved addition: 9 Best DocuSign Alternatives for Legal and Business Teams. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for docusign alternatives, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.

research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; Owner draft had no verified prices; all prices added from official pages on 2026-11-20. outline: How We Chose These DocuSign Alternatives
1. Adobe Acrobat: Best for PDF-Heavy Firms
2. Dropbox Sign: Best for Small Teams
3. PandaDoc: Best for Proposals and Quotes
5. BoldSign: Best for Developers and APIs
7. Zoho Sign: Best for Zoho Customers
8. Jotform Sign: Best for Forms That End in a Signature
9. OneSpan Sign: Best for High-Control Enterprise Signing
What 300 Envelopes a Year Costs on Three Plans
Choose by Workflow, Not Feature Count
excluded_claims: Unverifiable or blocked sources cut: ACC CLO survey figures, ABA Formal Opinions 08-451 and 512, ABA Business Law Section page, Clio pricing page, Reuters coverage of the ALSP report
drafting_cautions: Label vendor prices with the check date

claims.statement: DocuSign Standard costs $25 per user per month and Business Pro $40 per user per month, each with 100 envelopes per user per year; Personal is $10 per month with 5 envelopes a month.
Dropbox Sign Essentials costs $15 per month or $180 billed yearly; Standard costs $25 per user per month monthly or $17.50 per user per month billed yearly, with unlimited signature requests.
BoldSign Business costs $15 per user per month and Premium $99 per month, billed yearly; ID verification is $2 per verification; Enterprise API is $0.75 per envelope starting at $30 a month.
